title: drupilot target major (config/targets/<major>.json)
description: What one Drupal major needs, one file per major (10, 11, 12). Hand-maintained fields (status, the php_supported/php_unsupported support table, removals, defaults) sit next to fields scripts/dev/refresh-data.sh generates from git.drupalcode.org and packagist (each minor's latest tag, release date, php_min, php_recommended and the Symfony/Twig/PHPUnit/Coder/PHPStan constraints). Every leaf group carries its source (src, url or php_src) and verified; only verified groups that are never verified_as 'announced' may drive a hard gate, and the subschemas marked x-drupilot-hard-gate are exactly those groups (scripts/dev/data-check.sh enforces it). An unknown value is null, or a minor is {"status": "detect"}: unknown is detected at runtime, never assumed.

as_of.description: The date of the last change of a generated value (refresh-data.sh) or a hand edit.

status.description: supported | pre-release (needs an explicit opt-in) | eol. A data commit flips it; today's date never does.

upgrade_from_min.description: The oldest core a site must run before it can update to this major.

composer_stability_while_prerelease.description: The Composer stability flag a pre-release major needs (e.g. beta), else null.

toolchain_cell.description: The cell of config/toolchain-reference.json this major's test-beds use.

php_defaults.description: env: the DRUPILOT_PHP_TARGET default; tab: the PHP_TARGET tab's pre-selection (0.9 keeps them apart, CC-08).

default_ranges.description: The declared core range each compat strategy writes for this target (a product decision, not an ecosystem fact).

removed_extensions.description: Core modules and themes removed in a minor of this major (verified against the core tree at both tags).

deprecated_in.description: The version the library's own deprecated: message names, else null.

namespace_moves.description: Advisory notes (never a hard gate): code that moves to another namespace in a minor of this major.

classes.description: The classes that move (their short names), when not the whole namespace does.

hard_break_detectors.description: The detector ids (M6) that look for this major's hard breaks.

rector_sets.description: The fallback list of this major's per-minor drupal-rector set constants, used only when no test-bed can be reflected (the installed set list wins).

hand_sources.description: The drupal.org pages the hand-maintained fields come from, with the change date read when they were last checked; refresh-data.sh reports a page that changed since.

minor_detect.description: A minor not released yet (or not readable): every value is detected at runtime.

latest.description: Generated: the newest tag of this minor (a pre-release only for a pre-release major).

released.description: Generated: the date of the minor's .0 release, null while it is a pre-release.

php_min.description: Generated: core/composer.json require.php at the latest tag.

php_recommended.description: Generated: Drupal::RECOMMENDED_PHP at the latest tag.

php_supported.description: Hand: the PHP versions drupal.org's PHP requirements table marks Yes for this minor (null: the minor is not in the table).

php_unsupported.description: Hand: the PHP versions the table marks No. A version in neither list is unknown (e.g. 'Follow issue #3608511').

src.description: Generated: where the generated fields come from.

php_src.description: Hand: where php_supported/php_unsupported come from (null when both are null).

state_at_removal.description: absent (default): the extension is gone from the core tree; obsolete: still in the tree with lifecycle: obsolete, so it can no longer be installed.

introduced_in.description: For an extension core added after the previous major's newest release: the minor that adds it (its presence is checked there once that minor has a tag).

info_path.description: The extension's .info.yml path in the core tree when it is not core/modules/<name>/<name>.info.yml or core/themes/<name>/<name>.info.yml (a module nested under another).

replacement_project.description: The drupal.org project that carries it on, or null when nothing does.

rewrite.description: dependency: require the contrib project; base-theme: rebase the theme; hard-break: no automatic rewrite.
